intro: Production leadership at Teton Web and prior operator experience — AI orchestration, client advisory, and the kind of outcomes I'd bring to a customer-facing role at Cursor.

roles.title: Founder & Lead Developer
bullets: Founded and lead Teton Web, a specialized web development and AI orchestration consultancy delivering platforms, internal tooling, and adoption strategy for clients across industrial equipment, global nonprofit, insurance brokerage, and inventor-network markets. Serve as trusted technical advisor and de facto CTO on AI, platform, and web strategy.

Architected and productionized AI multi-agent orchestration systems that serve as force multipliers for development velocity, including Slack-based agents, cross-device automation, Linear/Slack task orchestration, and routine-maximization workflows. Used these systems to frame practical AI maturity, rollout risk, and workflow transformation for technical stakeholders.

Pioneered advanced Cursor and Composer 2.5 workflows that coordinate parallel sub-agents for issue execution and branch management. Public demos provided concrete proof points for AI-assisted software development maturity, adoption strategy, and engineering workflow transformation.

Led high-context client engagements, including major design-system proposal work, international platform/catalog delivery, and alumni-platform strategy facilitation. Comfortable operating as a peer to senior technical stakeholders while connecting architecture, implementation tradeoffs, and business outcomes.

Developing an all-in-one small business SaaS platform spanning website/CMS/CRM, realtime workflows, and AI. Manage proposals, contracts, financials, multi-tenant architecture, and product direction in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

roles.title: Owner / Operator
bullets: Built and managed hundreds of websites across Intuit Homestead, Wix, WordPress, Shopify, and Next.js, supporting clients from basic brochure sites to e-commerce and custom web applications.
Handled ongoing website operations including redesigns, migrations, domains, DNS, hosting coordination, content updates, storefront configuration, troubleshooting, and client training.
Operated a technology services business for small businesses and homes, resolving thousands of support cases across Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, networking, cloud, and dedicated-server environments.

Designed and maintained 50+ workstation business networks, Google Workspace profiles, IP printing, file sharing, backup/data-retention policies, phone systems, security administration, and paperless iPad workflows that saved hundreds of hours annually.
